The '''Great Seal''' was a large [[gold]]en disk created by the [[Aleena]] in the distant past as symbol of the separation of the Aleena and [[Kindalo]] races. Installed in the ground at a prominent site on [[Aleen]], it separated the surface world and the [[Aleen Underworld|Underworld]]. The efficacy of this device was questioned by [[scholar]]s, as the Underworld had many openings across the [[planet]]. Some scholars believed that the Great Seal was imbued with [[the Force]], which prevented the mixing of the two ecospheres through metaphysical means. The [[Jedi Order]] established a [[Jedi chapter house (Aleen)|chapter house]] at the site of Great Seal; the chapter house was abandoned long before the [[Clone Wars]]. During the war, the Seal was disturbed and the war between the Aleena and the Kindalo began again, causing the [[Galactic Republic]] to [[Mission to Aleen|intervene]] and reinstall the Seal.<ref name="NoP" />

==Description==
A large golden disk, the Great Seal was inlaid with intricate carvings. It featured three Aleena standing amid vines, one of them wearing a crown. Underneath a ribbon-like line that bisected the disk, there were roots, beetles, and what appeared to be stairs descending into the underworld.<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep405|text="Mercy Mission" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
